title: 3 Salting Methods for Better-Tasting Meats
summary: This video from America's Test Kitchen presents a practical, evidence-based look at three salt-application approaches for meat and fish: brining (salting in a saltwater solution), dry brining (salting directly on the surface and letting salt disperse into the meat), and seasoning (salting during cooking). It details how salt affects protein structure and water retention, provides specific brine concentrations and timing guidelines for different proteins, demonstrates a quick salmon brine, and shows poultry preparation that yields crispy skin through overnight air-drying. It also covers salt types and density differences, and ends with general seasoning rules, a three-finger technique for even distribution, and a reverse-sear pork demonstration, all aimed at helping cooks decide when and how to apply salt based on product size, timing, and space available.
